resources.name: A. POST create activity (full)
resources.description: Owner only. Expect 201. Saves the new id into activity_id. Run request 1 (sign in) and 2 (create trip) first.

resources.name: B. POST create activity (name only)
resources.description: Owner only. Expect 201 with cost 0, mandatory false, everything else null. Also saves activity_id.

resources.name: C. GET all activities for trip
resources.description: Owner or accepted member. Expect 200 with a list, earliest start time first.

resources.name: D. GET one activity
resources.description: Owner or accepted member. Expect 200. After F, expect 404 Activity not found.

resources.name: E. PUT update activity
resources.description: Owner only. Expect 200. PUT replaces EVERY field: send the whole activity, anything left out goes back to its default (cost 0, mandatory false, others null).

resources.name: F. DELETE activity
resources.description: Owner only. Expect 200 {"message": "Activity deleted."}. Then re-send D for a 404.

resources.name: Activity - error checks
resources.description: Each request should FAIL with the status in its name.

resources.name: 400 - ends before it starts
resources.description: Expect 400: End date and time cannot be before the start date and time.

resources.name: 403 - missing CSRF header
resources.description: No Authorization header on purpose. Expect 403 Invalid or missing CSRF token (401 if you are not signed in at all).

resources.name: 404 - activity does not exist
resources.description: Uses a well-formed id that no activity has. Expect 404 Activity not found.

resources.name: 400 - badly formed id
resources.description: abc is not a uuidv7. Expect 400.
